design_philosophy: E1 Focus Mode. An anti-distraction, highly calibrated instrument for speed reading Arabic text. We abandon standard 'SaaS dashboards' in favor of a 'Dark Room' theater experience for the reader, and a hyper-organized 'Swiss Grid' for the library. Typography is the interface. Tension is created through extreme negative space around the RSVP word.

typography.primary_heading: IBM Plex Sans Arabic (Geometric, authoritative, high-legibility for UI and Library)
typography.reader_display: Tajawal or Noto Kufi Arabic (Heavy weight, exceptional clarity for rapid word recognition)

scale.rsvp_word: text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[100px] font-black tracking-tighter leading-none

rules: No generic Sans (like Inter) - must use Arabic-optimized Google Fonts.
The RSVP word must use 'font-black' to ensure maximum visibility at high WPM.
UI Labels must be slightly letter-spaced (tracking-widest) to offset Arabic ligature density in small sizes.

colors.theme_strategy: The 'Performance Pro' Archetype. Deep Obsidian anchor with pure white for text clarity, and an Electric Crimson for the RSVP focal point.
rules: The RSVP Reader screen background MUST be solid Deep Obsidian (#0a0a0a) to kill glare and focus the eye.
The focal letter in the RSVP word MUST be highlighted in accent_focal (#e11d48).
Never use pure black (#000000); always use the tinted #0a0a0a.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Remove all soft drop shadows. Rely entirely on 1px borders and slight background lightening (e.g., #171717 to #262626) to show depth.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY on floating control bars in the Reader view (WPM slider, play/pause) to keep them visually subordinate to the text. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-t border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.radius: Minimal. Use rounded-none or rounded-sm (2px) to maintain a highly technical, precise feel.

buttons.primary: Solid accent_focal (#e11d48) with white text, sharp corners. Hover: #be123c.
buttons.ghost: Transparent background, text_secondary. Hover: bg-white/5 text-white.
buttons.play_pause: Massive, circular, centered below the word, or integrated into a bottom sticky control bar.

progress_bars.style: Ultra-thin (h-1), bg-neutral-800, indicator is white or accent_focal.

layouts.global: RTL Native. Sidebar on the RIGHT, main content on the LEFT.
layouts.login_page: Split screen. Right half: Arabic typography abstract image (darkened). Left half: Minimalist login form centered in vast negative space.

library_dashboard.grid: Bento Grid protocol. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6.
library_dashboard.spacing: Generous padding (p-8 or p-12) to feel premium.

reader_screen.top_bar: Minimalist header with 'Back to Library' and Document Title (opacity-50).
reader_screen.center_stage: Absolute vertical and horizontal center. Massive typography. This area must be surgically clean.
reader_screen.bottom_bar: Floating glassmorphic control center (Play, Pause, WPM Slider, Rewind, Forward).
reader_screen.side_panel: Collapsible left panel (since app is RTL) for 'Original Page View'.

motion.rsvp_word_switch: NO ANIMATION on word switch. It must be instant (0ms) to allow reading at 500-5000 WPM without motion blur. This is critical.
motion.controls: Hover states on buttons use rapid transition (duration-150).
motion.side_panel: Slide in from left edge using Framer Motion (x: '-100%' to x: 0).

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA compliance. White on Obsidian passes easily.
accessibility.keyboard: Space to Play/Pause, Left/Right arrows to Rewind/Forward, Up/Down to adjust WPM.

media_and_images.usage: Use the local CSS gradient as a full-bleed background with a heavy dark overlay.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: CRITICAL RTL SETUP: You MUST add `dir="rtl"` to the HTML tag and ensure the tailwind config supports logical properties (ms-, me-, ps-, pe-, start, end). Do NOT use ml-, mr-, pl-, pr-, left, right.
NO DEFAULT TRANSITIONS: Do not use `transition-all`. Specify `transition-colors`, `transition-opacity`, or `transition-transform`.
FONTS: Use local system fallbacks; do not require an external CDN.
RSVP LOGIC: Word rendering must be instant. The component handling the word display must be heavily optimized to prevent re-rendering the entire page at high WPM.

DATA-TESTID: ALL interactive elements (buttons, sliders, inputs) and key state indicators (status badges, warning banners) MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="play-pause-btn"`, `data-testid="wpm-slider"`).
DARK MODE: Force Dark Mode for the RSVP Reader screen, even if the user system is light, to reduce eye strain at high reading speeds.
TOASTS: Use Sonner for all notifications (upload success, OCR failure, position saved).
